example_sentences_in_bangla: সে টিউশনি করে অতিরিক্ত আয় করে।
example_sentences_in_english: I make ends meet by doing tuition.
She earns extra income by doing private tutoring.
note: This term is a colloquial adaptation of the English word 'tuition' and reflects the common practice of private tutoring in Bengali-speaking urban communities for supplemental income.
